--allowed-gadgets.help: List of allowed gadgets, if gadget is not part of it, execution will be denied. By default, all gadgets are allowed.

--as.help: Username to impersonate for the operation

--as-group.help: Group to impersonate for the operation, this flag can be repeated to specify multiple groups.

--authfile.help: Path of the authentication file. This overrides the REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE environment variable

--btfhub-archive.help: Path to the location of the btfhub-archive files

--builder-image-pull.help: Specify when the builder image should be pulled [always, missing, never]

--certificate-authority.help: Path to a cert file for the certificate authority

--client-certificate.help: Path to a client certificate file for TLS

--client-key.help: Path to a client key file for TLS

--cluster.help: The name of the kubeconfig cluster to use

--conclusion.help: conclusion (success, failure, skipped and cancelled) indicating GitHub Action test step status

--containerid.help: container id to use in add-container or remove-container

--containername.help: container name to use in add-container

--context.help: The name of the kubeconfig context to use

--controller.help: Enable the controller for custom resources

--daemon-config.help: Path to a config file to override the daemon configuration values. The file must be in YAML format

--docker-socketpath.help: Docker Engine API Unix socket path (default "/run/docker.sock")

--dump.help: Dump state for debugging specifying the items to print: containers, traces, stacks, all

--events.help: Comma-separated list of event generators with their configuration (example: dns:server=1.1.1.1,tcp:server=localhost:8080,exec)

--events-per-second.help: Maximum requests per second (0 for unlimited)

--fallback-podinformer.help: Use pod informer as a fallback for main hook

--gadgets-public-keys.help: Public keys used to verify the gadgets

--hook-mode.help: how to get containers start/stop notifications (podinformer, fanotify, auto, none)

--in.help: path to JSON file produced by go tool test2json

--insecure.help: Allow connections to HTTP only registries

--insecure-registries.help: List of registries to access over plain HTTP

--insecure-skip-tls-verify.help: If true, the server's certificate will not be checked for validity. This will make your HTTPS connections insecure

--jsonpath.help: JSONPath to extract from the extra info

--k8s-containername.help: Show data only from containers with the name defined in the pod spec

--k8s-namespace.help: Show only data from pods in a given Kubernetes namespace

--k8s-podname.help: Show only data from Kubernetes pods with that name

--kubeconfig.help: Path to the kubeconfig file to use for CLI requests.

--label.help: key=value,key=value labels to use in add-tracer

--liveness.help: Execute as client and perform liveness probe

--liveness-socketfile.help: Path to socket file for liveness checks

--no-trunc.help: Don't truncate output, this option is only valid when used in a terminal

--node.help: Show only data from pods running in that node

--notation-certificates.help: Certificates used to verify the gadgets with notation

--notation-policy-document.help: Policy Document used to verify the gadgets with notation

--otel-metrics-listen.help: Enable OpenTelemetry metrics listener (Prometheus compatible) endpoint

--otel-metrics-listen-address.help: Address and port to create the OpenTelemetry metrics listener (Prometheus compatible) on

--pprof-addr.help: Starts a pprof server for profiling at the given address (e.g., 'localhost:6060'), leave empty to disable (default).

--profile-prefix.help: Name prefix of the seccomp profile to be created when using --output-mode=seccomp-profile.\nNamespace can be specified by using namespace/profile-prefix.

--public-keys.help: Public keys used to verify the gadgets with cosign

--request-timeout.help: The length of time to wait before giving up on a single server request. Non-zero values should contain a corresponding time unit (e.g. 1s, 2m, 3h). A value of zero means don't timeout requests. (default "0")

--runtimes.help: Comma-separated list of container runtimes. Supported values are: docker, containerd, cri-o, podman (default "docker,containerd,cri-o,podman")

--set-daemon-config.help: Set a key-value pair in the daemon configuration. The format is key=value. This flag can be used multiple times to set multiple values. Only recommended for primitive values (string, int, bool). For complex values, use --daemon-config flag with a YAML file.

--timeout.help: Number of seconds that the gadget will run for

--tls-client-ca-file.help: Path to CA certificate for client validation

--tls-insecure.help: Allow insecure connections from clients (no certificate validation)

--tls-server-name.help: Server name to use for server certificate validation. If it is not provided, the hostname used to contact the server is used

--token.help: Bearer token for authentication to the API server

--update-from-path.help: if set, update files from the local path to a inspektor-gadget git repository

--update-metadata.help: Update the metadata according to the eBPF code

--user.help: The name of the kubeconfig user to use

--validate-metadata.help: Validate the metadata file before building the gadget image

--verify-gadgets.help: Verify gadgets using the provided public keys

--watch.help: After listing the containers, watch for new containers

advise.help: Recommend system configurations based on collected information

daemon.help: Run Inspektor Gadget as a daemon

delete.help: Delete one or more gadget instances

deploy.help: Deploy Inspektor Gadget on the cluster

export.help: Export the SRC_IMAGE images to DST_FILE

health.help: Check the gadget installation on a Kubernetes cluster

install.help: Install or reinstall Inspektor Gadget on the worker nodes

kubectl-gadget.help: Collection of gadgets for Kubernetes developers

list.help: List gadget images on the host

network-policy.help: Generate network policies based on recorded network activity

pull.help: Pull the specified image from a remote registry

push.help: Push the specified image to a remote registry

seccomp-profile.help: Generate seccomp profiles based on recorded syscalls activity

show.help: Show details of a gadget instance

start.help: Start to monitor the system calls

stop.help: Stop monitoring and report the policies

tag.help: Tag the local SRC_IMAGE image with the DST_IMAGE

tcptop.help: Show the TCP traffic in a pod

traceloop.help: Get strace-like logs of a container from the past

verify.help: Verify gadget signature using local store
